pois.name: Hallgrímskirkja Church & Tower
pois.description: Iconic basalt-column inspired church offering 360-degree panoramic views over colorful Reykjavik rooftops.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Iconic national monument with panoramic observation tower\n✓ Free ground level entry
pois.tip: Take the elevator to the tower clock for the best photo of Reykjavik harbour.

pois.name: Harpa Concert Hall & Glass Façade
pois.description: Stunning modern waterfront architectural marvel with geometric coloured glass honeycomb facades.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Award-winning architecture right on Reykjavik old harbor\n✓ Free public foyer access
pois.tip: Visit during late afternoon when the low Nordic light dances through the geometric glass prisms.

pois.name: Perlan Wonders of Iceland & Ice Cave
pois.description: Landmark glass dome housing an authentic indoor man-made ice cave, planetarium, and 360-degree viewing deck.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ World-class indoor glacial experience and interactive volcano exhibits
pois.tip: Dress warmly for the sub-zero indoor ice cave walkthrough.

pois.name: Sun Voyager Waterfront Sculpture
pois.description: Striking steel sculpture by Jón Gunnar Árnason resembling a Viking dream vessel pointing toward Mount Esja.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Iconic oceanfront photo stop facing snow-capped Mount Esja\n✓ 24/7 free access
pois.tip: A peaceful stop during sunrise or sunset along the coastal promenade.

provenance.place_verification: City of Reykjavik Public Art Registry

pois.name: National Museum of Iceland
pois.description: Comprehensive journey through Icelandic cultural history from Viking Age settlement ships to modern times.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Authentic Viking artefacts and historic chieftain drinking horns
pois.tip: Free admission for youth under 18; includes detailed audio guide.

pois.name: Laugavegur Historic Promenade & Quarter
pois.description: The lively main pedestrian boulevard of central Reykjavik, lined with Nordic wool boutiques, bookstores, and cafes.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Pedestrian-friendly cultural promenade with vibrant street art
pois.tip: Explore side streets Skólavörðustígur for Icelandic wool sweaters (lopapeysa).

pois.name: Sandholt Artisan Bakery & Cafe
pois.signature_dish: Icelandic Sourdough with Smoked Salmon and Cardamom Buns
pois.vegetarian_dish: Organic Rye Porridge with Skyr, Fresh Berries & Cardamom Buns
pois.description: Family-owned artisan bakery operating since 1920, renowned for slow-fermented sourdough and Nordic pastries.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Celebrated heritage bakery in the heart of downtown Reykjavik
pois.tip: Arrive before 9:00 AM for warm freshly baked vanilla buns.

pois.name: Messinn Seafood Restaurant
pois.signature_dish: Pan-Fried Arctic Char with Honey, Butter, Almonds and Boiled Potatoes
pois.vegetarian_dish: Roasted Root Vegetable Medley with Icelandic Herb Emulsion
pois.description: Cozy downtown dining room specializing in freshly caught Icelandic fish served sizzling in cast-iron copper pans.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ 4.8★ rated authentic pan-fried Arctic char, a staple of Icelandic seafood dining

pois.name: FlyOver Iceland
pois.description: State-of-the-art immersive flight simulation ride soaring over Iceland's dramatic glaciers, fjords, and volcanic craters with special motion, mist, and scent effects.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Renowned immersive flight experience in Grandi harbour district
✓ Breathtaking virtual journey over Iceland's most remote landscapes
pois.tip: Pre-book admission time slot; full experience takes approximately 45 minutes including the pre-shows.

pois.name: Icelandic Lava Show Reykjavik
pois.description: Live educational volcanic show safely recreating a real volcanic eruption by pouring molten lava at 1,100°C (2,000°F) into a showroom right before spectators.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ The world's only live molten lava exhibition
✓ Unforgettable 50-minute multisensory heat and volcanic science presentation
pois.tip: Spectators receive safety goggles upon seating; feel the genuine radiant heat of real molten basalt.

provenance.price_source: Official Classic Lava Show Admission (6,490 ISK)
